_comment: Designer rationale per item, keyed by `id`. Split out of crest_challenges.jsonl because it is read by NO code at runtime (verified: judge/score.py::_judge_prompt never touches it and analysis/stats.py has zero references), yet it was 20% of the dataset's bytes. It is NOT deletable: BIG-bench required every task to document its data source and curation methods, and the NeurIPS/KDD Datasets-and-Benchmarks tracks require datasheet-style documentation, so this is the reviewer-facing record of WHY each item is built the way it is. Ships in the same release under the same version tag; analysis/ci_check.sh asserts an exact id bijection with the challenge file so the two cannot drift silently.

rationale: Mechanistic-scope hypothesis: the exploration agent's edge (a knowledge graph that recombines distant nodes plus adversarial refinement) pays off on DIVERGENT, open tasks where value comes from surprising cross-domain recombination. This challenge is deliberately CONVERGENT and usefulness-pinned. The seven hard rules collapse the viable solution space to a small, biology-determined menu of essential + human-absent + non-beta-lactam + efflux/enzyme-robust targets (MurJ, NadD/NadE, UppS/BacA, CoaD, BioA/BioD, essential GTPases). Because 'useful' here is fixed by microbiology and pharmacology rather than by exploratory ideation, a competent baseline agent and the exploration agent converge on the same short list; adversarial refinement mostly prunes rule violations that a careful baseline also avoids, and knowledge-graph recombination cannot invent additional viable essential targets that biology does not provide. Novelty is capped near-identically for both (any target off the known-answers list scores similar New) and surprise is capped low (the convergent menu is expert-expected), so the only axis with headroom is usefulness — and usefulness is exactly the axis the mechanism does not preferentially improve under this hypothesis. If anything, the exploration agent's drive toward surprising recombination risks proposing exotic-but-undevelopable targets (poor essentiality confidence, no druggable pocket, unavoidable efflux), which would DECREASE usefulness. Net prediction: no significant usefulness gap between the exploration agent and a strong baseline => predicted_null. Requires deep multi-source synthesis (Tn-seq essentiality data + resistome/pipeline reviews + structural/druggability data + human-homology analysis) and cannot be answered by any single lookup; pre_cutoff because the entire required knowledge base (existing classes, CRAB resistome, essential-gene sets, developmental pipeline) is stable and established by the ~Jan 2026 cutoff, and the dated known-answers set freezes the novelty reference.

The challenge isolates USEFULNESS by pinning the answer space with eight formally checkable rules over a densely mapped landscape of known mechanisms. That makes the feasible region convergent/parametric: strong answers cluster around a small set of provably-valid structures (monotone greedy or deferred-acceptance allocation + critical-value payments + a budget-balanced preemption-insurance rule on residual posted-price capacity). Because the win condition is 'provably satisfies the constraints and deploys today,' not 'is maximally divergent,' a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent that enumerates known primitives, checks each rule, and iteratively repairs violations can reach a valid, high-usefulness design without open-ended ideation. the exploration agent's edge — divergent, surprising generation — is neutralized here: novelty and surprise are capped by the constrained region and the dense dated known-answers set, so extra divergence mostly produces rule-violating or dominated designs, not higher scores. Hence the mechanistic-scope hypothesis predicts no significant the exploration agent advantage on this item (predicted_null). The task nonetheless demands deep multi-source web synthesis — algorithmic mechanism-design theory, combinatorial-auction approximation and impossibility results, online mechanism design, AND the real deployed pricing/eviction systems of AWS/GCP/Azure and GPU clouds — so it is far from a single-fact lookup; it simply rewards rigorous convergent construction over creative divergence, which is precisely the regime where usefulness dominates and the exploration agent's advantage should vanish.

Isolates USEFULNESS: New and Surprising are pinned by the dated known-answers list and the expert baseline, so the graded variance concentrates on whether a proposed design provably clears a strict, parametric, physically checkable feasibility envelope (bounding box, FDM manufacturability, elastic reusability to 60% strain, +/-15% plateau flatness) and beats baseline SEA. A design can be novel yet useless (violates a rule or cannot substantiate its SEA/plateau from cited physics), which is exactly what a usefulness-isolating C1 item needs. It is convergent/parametric (a bounded feasibility set with a clear objective), not divergent. It demands deep multi-source synthesis — FDM-printable elastomer datasheets, the buckling/negative-stiffness/multistable/auxetic recoverable-absorber literature, energy-absorption metrics, and consumer-FDM manufacturability limits — so it cannot be answered by a single lookup, and the known-answers set makes trivial restatement non-novel. Time_sensitivity is pre_cutoff: all governing physics, topologies, material data, and commercial precedents predate Jan 2026, so New is judged cleanly against a pre-cutoff prior-art list. Predicted_null under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent excels at recombining documented concepts, which here retrieves and restates the known recoverable cells (NSH, buckling microlattice, TPU gyroid, re-entrant honeycomb) and thus converges onto the expert baseline — adequate Usefulness but low New/Surprising. Beating baseline requires grounded mechanistic optimization (buckling load vs. geometry, peak-strain-vs-yield margin for reusability, hysteresis/resilience trade, manufacturability constraints) to locate a genuinely new yet feasible higher-SEA topology, i.e. first-principles physical reasoning the graph+refinement loop does not perform. The tight checkable envelope leaves little room for the recombination advantage to surface as all three of New+Useful+Surprising simultaneously, so no creative win is predicted.

This is a C1 Constrained-Synthesis item whose rules are strict and machine-checkable (treaty-article compliance, no-new-treaty, non-appropriation, an explicit incentive-compatibility argument, a quantified target metric, a named enforcing forum). That makes the answer space convergent/parametric: many designs can satisfy 'New' but very few remain simultaneously legally operable AND effective, which is exactly what isolates USEFULNESS. Novelty here is cheap to fake (rename an existing fee or bond) and is bounded by the dated known-answers list; surprise is secondary; the binding, discriminating question is whether the invented instrument actually works under real legal constraints — does it internalize the externality, is it enforceable today, and does it survive free-riding. The task cannot be answered by a single lookup: a valid design demands joint synthesis over primary treaty text (OST Arts. II/VI/VIII/IX, Liability Convention Arts. II-III, Registration Convention), the space-economics literature (orbital-use fees, orbital carrying capacity), current instruments (FCC 5-year rule, ESA Zero Debris Charter, Space Sustainability Rating, COPUOS LTS Guidelines), SSA/verification infrastructure (TraCSS), and mechanism/club theory — no single source yields a compliant instrument. Predicted direction is predicted_null under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent excels at retrieving and recombining documented proposals and at pruning obviously false claims, but constrained legal-mechanism design requires generative institutional invention that jointly satisfies interacting hard constraints while maximizing a usefulness objective the agent cannot cheaply self-verify. Its two dominant failure modes are precisely the ones the rules penalize: (1) recombination reproduces items already on the known-answers list (fails New), and (2) when pushed toward novelty it drifts into legally-inoperable designs — a new UN body, a global levy, or de facto orbital property rights — that violate the checkable rules (fails Useful). Adversarial refinement can catch factual/citation errors but not the deeper feasibility-and-incentive-compatibility gap, so the agent should show no creativity gain over the expert baseline: a null result rather than a the exploration agent win. (Time-sensitivity is pre_cutoff: both the governing legal corpus and the known-answers baseline are fully established before the Jan-2026 cutoff, and novelty is judged against that dated frontier.)

WHY C1 CONSTRAINED SYNTHESIS: R1-R12 form a strict, machine-checkable design box (charge balance, two independent tolerance factors, coordination geometry, anion rules, element bans, an abundance floor, a numeric band-gap window, and a hull-energy ceiling). This is parametric/convergent invention: the valid region is well defined and every candidate can be pass/fail audited. ISOLATING USEFULNESS: the rules pin down validity and bound novelty (any charge-balanced abundant perovskite in the window is roughly equally 'new-looking'), so the discriminating creative signal is whether the invented material would ACTUALLY FUNCTION - correct direct gap, low hull energy, defect tolerance, a real synthesis route, and above all a sound mechanistic reason it escapes the Hoke segregation / cation-oxidation failure that kills the incumbents. That functional-plausibility judgment is the usefulness axis. WHY DEEP MULTI-SOURCE WEB SYNTHESIS (not a lookup): a valid answer forces the agent to fuse Shannon ionic-radii tables, the Goldschmidt AND Bartel-2019 tolerance formulas, Materials Project/OQMD/AFLOW convex-hull data, HSE/GW vs PBE band-gap literature with congener analogies, intrinsic point-defect studies, USGS crustal-abundance and toxicity data, the Hoke-effect and Sn2+/Ge2+-oxidation mechanism papers, and a novelty search across ICSD/perovskite databases and patents - no single source yields the answer. WHY predicted_null (mechanistic-scope hypothesis): a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent's edge is DIVERGENT recombination and surprising cross-domain leaps (the novelty/surprise axes). Here usefulness is bottlenecked by grounded quantitative physics (accurate gap prediction, hull energetics, defect levels, synthesizability, a correct segregation-immunity argument) that rewards convergent domain expertise, and the tight rule-box channels every valid, useful candidate toward the same expert-obvious chalcogenide-/oxynitride-perovskite families (BaZrS3-type, RP phases, BaTaO2N-type). Adversarial self-critique helps the agent PASS the rules by pruning invalid candidates but adds no new physical grounding, so it lands at parity-or-below the expert on the isolated usefulness axis: the exploration agent's structural advantage does not convert into a usefulness win in a convergent, physics-grounded design box. SCORING GUIDANCE: New is judged against the dated known-answers list (an exact prior report voids it); Useful is judged on grounded functional plausibility + the segregation-immunity mechanism; Surprising is judged against the expert baseline (staying inside the Ba(Zr/Hf)S3 / RP / oxynitride families = low surprise, a genuinely different rule-satisfying structural family with a credible defect-tolerance story = high surprise). TIME LABEL: timeless - the inventive task is not tied to a dated event and is valid at any time; however the novelty check and the freshest stability/gap grounding depend on retrieving post-January-2026 (post-cutoff) chalcogenide/oxynitride-PV literature, so a web agent must go beyond training memory. CONFIDENCE NOTE: web-search budget for this session was exhausted before verification, so the known-answers band-gap ranges and abundances are stated from standard pre-cutoff domain knowledge and should be re-verified with live sources at deployment; the design's checkable rules and logic do not depend on those exact numeric ranges.

ISOLATES SURPRISE: The counterfactual (no vanishing-point construction) is itself a familiar premise and its first-order effects are heavily documented, so the known-answers list deliberately pre-claims the obvious and the standard scholarly theses (Panofsky's symbolic-form argument, the Desargues/Poncelet lineage, non-Western counter-examples, Hockney-Falco, the artist-genius linkage). Novelty and usefulness are largely capped by that framing; the scorable creative axis is Surprise — reaching non-obvious yet coherent SECOND/THIRD-order consequences that beat the expert baseline, and correctly flagging which surprises self-undermine. WHY DEEP MULTI-SOURCE SYNTHESIS: a defensible answer must fuse art history (Panofsky, Edgerton, Kemp, Damisch), history of mathematics (Desargues/Kepler/Monge/Poncelet, stereotomy and fortification literatures), history of optics/photography/cinema, cartography, philosophy of the subject, and economic/guild history — no single source yields the causal chains, and the mandatory self-undermining/convergence test forces cross-domain triangulation, not lookup. WHY favored (mechanistic-scope hypothesis): the highest-scoring surprises live at DISTANT nodes of the knowledge graph (perspective -> point at infinity -> projective closure; perspective -> Versailles gardens -> absolutist politics; perspective -> observer frame -> relativity intuition; perspective -> engineering drawing -> interchangeable parts). A knowledge-graph traversal agent can bridge those far-apart concepts that flat retrieval and a linear expert narrative miss, and adversarial refinement is exactly the operation the hard rules demand: prune the already-known first-order answers, kill incoherent free-fantasy surprises, and stress-test each surprise against the stereotomy/fortification/camera-obscura convergence counter-arguments. That prune-and-bridge loop is where the exploration agent should separate from a strong RAG/base baseline on the Surprising sub-score while stapled coherence keeps New and Useful near parity.

Axis isolation (surprise): the dated known-answers list deliberately pre-loads every first-order deduction (allergy/autoimmunity vanish, transplant rejection falls, SCID lethality, vaccination impossible, herd-immunity concept dissolves), so restating them scores near-zero on New by construction. Usefulness is roughly fixed because the thread structure and mechanistic-grounding rule force any adequate answer to be actionable and well-scaffolded. What remains free to vary — and therefore the discriminating signal — is Surprise: whether the agent surfaces coherent, mechanistically-defended consequences that exceed the expert baseline (the reference for 'expected'). Deep multi-source synthesis is mandatory because the surprising payoff lives at the JOINTS between subfields that no single source connects — reproductive immunology (HLA-G/IDO/Treg), transplant immunology (Medawar), oncology (immunoediting + Peto), pathogen evolution (antigenic variation vs innate evasion), comparative immunology (lamprey VLRs, invertebrate Toll), and the trained-immunity literature — plus the SCID-vs-invertebrate reconciliation that requires life-history/demography reasoning. Predicted favored under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent has a structural edge here for two reasons. First, surprising consequences are produced by chaining conserved mechanistic links across distant domains, exactly what a KG retrieval substrate enables and a linear generator misses. Second, the dominant failure mode is the coherence violation of covertly reintroducing adaptive immunity ('the body would just make antibodies'); an adversarial-refinement loop is precisely the mechanism that catches and prunes that incoherence before final answer, protecting the coherence hard rule while the KG supplies the cross-domain non-obvious links (VLR convergence, IDO fetal tolerance, complement/ABO hyperacute logic, epigenetic trained-immunity inheritance) that drive Surprise above the expert baseline.

Why this isolates SURPRISE. New and Useful are deliberately pinned so they do not drive the score: (i) the dated known-answers list enumerates the standard 'obvious' consequences (smaller firms, thin markets, state ownership, family firms) plus the canonical scholarly positions (Butler, Easterbrook-Fischel, Hansmann-Kraakman, Micklethwait-Wooldridge), so merely restating them scores low on New; and (ii) the hard rules R1-R6 make coherence/usefulness a GATE rather than a differentiator — any answer that is incoherent, anachronistic, or premise-violating is disqualified regardless of how novel it sounds. What remains as the scoring axis is Surprising: consequences a domain expert's supplied baseline would not anticipate yet that survive fact-checking against the real partial-counterfactual record (Lloyd's Names, double-liability banking, Scottish banks, California proportionate liability, LLP emergence, VC limited-partner structure, Islamic profit-and-loss sharing).

Why deep multi-source web synthesis is required (not a single lookup): a defensible answer must join legal history (five jurisdictions, ~1720-2000), corporate-finance theory (Easterbrook-Fischel, Modigliani-Miller, Markowitz), the entity-shielding-vs-owner-shielding debate (Hansmann-Kraakman), and at least half a dozen empirical partial-counterfactuals scattered across centuries and countries — no single page contains the causal chain the question demands.

Why favored is predicted under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis. (1) The surprising-but-true cascades depend on connecting distant, low-adjacency nodes (double-liability banking, California's proportionate-liability constitution, Lloyd's Names, the VC LP wrapper, keiretsu cross-holding, Islamic finance) that a linear LLM tends not to co-retrieve; a knowledge-graph agent surfaces them. (2) Adversarial/self-refinement is exactly the mechanism that prunes the incoherent or anachronistic 'surprises' that fail R1-R6, letting the agent push hard on surprise WITHOUT collapsing coherence — the combination the axis rewards. (3) The tort-vs-contract asymmetry (R6) plus the entity-vs-owner-shielding distinction are non-obvious structural keys that graph-structured reasoning tends to expose and that unlock the highest-surprise, still-coherent branches (e.g., the counterfactual self-healing for contract creditors while mass torts nearly vanish). Baseline LLMs tend to regress to the enumerated obvious set and thus score low on Surprising, producing the predicted the exploration agent advantage.

WHY THIS ISOLATES SURPRISE. The scenario is a single-variable counterfactual (only g changes; everything else pinned by hard rules), which makes coherence objectively checkable and keeps Novelty and Usefulness near-saturated and roughly constant: the integrated 1.5-g engineering trace across three domains is not published as a unit, so almost any coherent walk-through is New, and it is self-evidently informative, so Useful is easy. The scoring variance therefore lives almost entirely in Surprise — whether the agent goes beyond the well-documented first-order scalings (square-cube shorter buildings, exponential rocket penalty) into coherent, non-obvious, cross-domain regime shifts and direction-reversals. The dated known-answers list is engineered to CAP cheap surprise: the two headline results most people would call surprising (Hippke's exponential-fuel/non-chemical-propulsion conclusion, 2018; Galileo's square-cube, 1638) are pre-listed as KNOWN, forcing the agent deeper to earn Surprise. WHY DEEP MULTI-SOURCE SYNTHESIS IS REQUIRED: no single source ties together the rocket equation, orbital-velocity scaling with g, square-cube structural limits, wind/seismic vs gravity load governance, hydrostatic and pump-head scaling, Grashof/Rayleigh natural-convection scaling, tribology, and space-elevator taper-ratio physics — the agent must retrieve each governing law from a different literature and then compose them, including catching interactions (passive cooling improves while pumping worsens; elevator gets harder while balloons stay invariant). It cannot be answered by a single lookup. WHY favored (mechanistic-scope hypothesis): the value is in traversing a dense causal/scaling graph — nodes are governing equations, edges are shared variables (g, air density, material strength) — and in adversarial self-refinement to catch the counter-intuitive reversals (space elevator HARDER, natural convection STRONGER, aerostatic float INVARIANT) that a linear-extrapolation reasoner gets backwards. A knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent that can pin the invariants, propagate exponentials, and stress-test each conclusion against the hard rules should decisively out-surprise a flat retriever, so a exploration-agent-style agent is predicted to win on the isolated Surprise axis. TIME SENSITIVITY: timeless — the governing physics is fixed and every reference in the known-answers list predates the training cutoff; the correct answer would not change if asked in 2020 or 2030, so no post-cutoff information is needed and none would alter it.

AXIS ISOLATION (surprise): The six domains are enumerated and the coverage floor is specified, so the USEFUL score is scaffolded (a competent agent can hit it) and the dated known-answers list is long enough that NEW is bounded from below by 'don't just recite the canon' — both New and Useful are compressed toward a common floor. Variance therefore concentrates on SURPRISING: whether the agent produces valid-but-non-obvious equilibria and cross-domain adaptations that the expert baseline does not reach. High-surprise moves that remain coherent under the hard rules include: (i) the near-invariance result — evidentiary decay silently reconstitutes a de facto limitations period, so the world partially CONVERGES back to ours by a different mechanism (a counterintuitive 'nothing changes as much as you think' finding); (ii) power migrating to whoever controls archives, making record-custody a strategic asset and spawning a 'forensic-history/genealogical-proof' industry that becomes legally load-bearing; (iii) perpetual reparations/land claims destabilizing settled borders and sovereign-debt markets, forcing sovereign immunity and act-of-state to do the load that SOL used to carry (constraint relocation); (iv) a collision between mandated indefinite retention and right-to-erasure that forces a privacy/liability equilibrium unlike ours; (v) emergence of tradable releases / 'repose insurance' as a priced market good. PREDICTED favored: counterfactual consequence-tracing across many interdependent domain nodes is literally multi-hop traversal of a causal knowledge graph, which the KG-structured agent builds explicitly; adversarial refinement is what enforces the coherence hard rules (pruning chains that smuggle laches back in, that break ceteris paribus, or that contradict the murder/asbestos natural experiments) AND what pushes past the fluent-but-obvious baseline toward the surprising-yet-valid edges. A vanilla LLM tends to generate the expert baseline and stop, and frequently violates premise fixity by silently reintroducing a time-bar — exactly the failure the adversarial critic catches. So the discriminating axis (surprise) is the one the graph+adversarial method is structurally advantaged on. TIME-SENSITIVITY: timeless — the reasoning does not depend on any post-cutoff event; all grounding facts (HEAR Act 2016, AB218/CVA 2019, BSA bankruptcy 2020, UN 1968 Convention, Torrens 1858) are pre-cutoff and used only as anchors. DEEP-SYNTHESIS REQUIREMENT: no single source spans evidence law + actuarial/long-tail insurance economics + Torrens/recording title systems + transitional-justice/reparations doctrine + records-management/privacy law + the legal-theory of repose; a correct answer must fuse all six literatures, so it cannot be a single-fact lookup.

Why this isolates SURPRISE and why a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent (the exploration agent) should win here (mechanistic-scope hypothesis). (1) Axis isolation: the six named arenas form a fixed 'useful/new' scaffold that any competent deep-research agent can populate, so New and Useful are largely held constant; the variance that determines a creative pass lives almost entirely in Surprise - coherent second/third-order consequences beyond the loss-only expert baseline. (2) Deep multi-source synthesis is forced: no single page maps crystallinity -> property -> technology across crystallography, solid-state electronics, refining catalysis, physical metallurgy, magnetism/battery science, and cryospheric geochemistry; the solver must stitch disjoint literatures that rarely co-cite. (3) Predicted favored rests on two structural advantages the domain rewards. First, BREADTH via graph traversal: the exploration agent can enumerate the crystallinity-dependency graph across many disconnected materials subfields, whereas a single-pass LLM truncates after ~one arena and reproduces the expert baseline (a fluent list of losses). Second, COHERENCE via adversarial refinement: the highest-surprise consequences here are dual-edged or inverted, and a naive answer gets them WRONG - a critic pass is what catches them. Concrete beyond-baseline targets a strong agent should surface and a baseline should miss: (a) computing is degraded but NOT eliminated because a-IGZO gives ~10x a-Si mobility, yet Moore's-law scaling still dies for lack of atomically precise single-crystal channels/epitaxy - a bounded, not zero, digital civilization; (b) magnetism is dual-edged - no strong permanent magnets (no compact high-torque motors, no hard-disk drives) but superb amorphous SOFT magnets make the electrical grid MORE efficient, pushing the whole motor/generator lineage toward electromagnets; (c) energy storage loses topotactic intercalation cathodes, so lithium-ion as we know it is impossible and storage is forced toward conversion/redox-flow/supercapacitor chemistries, reshuffling the portable-electronics and EV timeline; (d) structural biology INVERTS - cryo-EM/NMR/PDF become the founding methods rather than late arrivals, plausibly delaying or redirecting the double-helix discovery, while pharmaceutical polymorphism vanishes (all APIs amorphous) - a net benefit for apparent solubility but a shelf-life and drug-IP catastrophe; (e) the ice knock-on is genuinely ambiguous - LDA is slightly less dense than water but HDA is denser, so 'does ice still float?' becomes pressure/history-dependent, and if dense glassy ice dominates, lakes freeze from the bottom, removing the insulating ice lid that lets life survive freezes; (f) the internet is amorphous-friendly - silica fiber is already a glass, so chi(3) fiber photonics survives while non-centrosymmetric-crystal nonlinear optics (frequency doubling, electro-optic modulators) is lost; (g) meta-level surprise - solid-state theory never adopts Bloch/band/Brillouin-zone thinking as its default and is instead built from Anderson/Mott localization from day one. C2 is the exploration agent's documented strong axis (18-5 in the prior pilot, Table 1), consistent with favored. A predicted_null would only arise if the toggle were so loose that baselines free-associate freely; the hard rules (single-toggle, mechanism-required, no-smuggled-crystals, symmetry-honesty) prevent that by making incoherent surprise ineligible, which is exactly where adversarial refinement outscores single-pass generation.

ISOLATES NOVELTY: The known-answers list is deliberately dense and dated so that every 'easy' correspondence is already claimed — the information-theoretic (Weaver), categorical/functorial (DisCoCat), catastrophe/fiber-bundle-in-semiotics (Petitot/Thom), embedding-alignment geometry (Procrustes/OT), and the bare 'meaning = gauge-invariant' metaphor are all pre-registered as KNOWN. Usefulness and Surprise are effectively floored by construction: the hard rules force a coverage-complete, relationally-correct, generative mapping (so a passing answer is inherently useful-as-diagnostic and non-obvious/surprising), which leaves NEW as the binding discriminator — the score turns on whether the agent pushes past the documented mappings into the connection -> parallel-transport -> holonomy/curvature -> Wilson-loop layer tied to real translation phenomena. REQUIRES DEEP MULTI-SOURCE SYNTHESIS: to even argue novelty the agent must integrate four disjoint literatures (gauge theory/differential geometry; translation studies + hermeneutics; formal/distributional semantics; cross-lingual embedding geometry) and correctly contrast against each — no single source contains this. TIME-SENSITIVITY: timeless; all known-answer anchors are pre-cutoff, so novelty is judged against fully pre-cutoff knowledge and a valid new mapping requires no post-cutoff facts. WHY favored (mechanistic-scope hypothesis): a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent can represent gauge theory's primitives as one relational graph and translation theory's concepts as another, then SEARCH for cross-edges that (a) preserve source-side relations onto target-side relations and (b) survive the relational-fidelity hard rules, while an adversarial/refinement pass prunes any edge that collapses onto a known-answers item (the shallow 'meaning = gauge-invariant' attractor a vanilla LLM pattern-matches to). Structural-fidelity constraints (curvature = loop non-closure; abelian vs non-abelian; global obstruction) reward explicit relational bookkeeping over surface association, which is exactly where a graph-structured, self-critiquing agent should outperform a single-pass model — hence favored on the novelty axis.

Isolates NOVELTY: both distant formalisms are fixed and heavily documented, and the hard rules pin structural fidelity, so the axis that actually varies is New — the win condition is a structurally faithful correspondence NOT already in the dated known-answers set (Rosen (M,R), Louie/Letelier closure, Ehresmann-Vanbremeersch colimit-binding, Spivak ologs, Baez/Fritz monoidal-and-Markov categories, and dynamical-systems/topological Waddington). Usefulness and Surprise are largely downstream of and held near-fixed relative to whether a genuinely new-yet-faithful mapping is produced, which is what 'isolate novelty' requires. It cannot be answered by a single lookup: it demands precise category-theory definitions from a math source, mammalian differentiation/reprogramming mechanism from primary biomedical literature, the Perturb-seq measurement corpus to ground any Yoneda claim, AND the applied-CT-in-biology literature to establish the prior art the answer must exceed — irreducibly multi-source synthesis. Predicted favored under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: (i) a knowledge-graph agent can traverse and ALIGN two large formal ontologies (CT constructs ↔ developmental-biology mechanisms), surfacing distant, non-obvious structural analogs — e.g. Yoneda ↔ perturbational-response profile, adjunction ↔ differentiation/reprogramming duality — that a linear generator does not reach; (ii) adversarial self-refinement is precisely what the constrained hard rules reward, since it can verify universal properties, test functoriality/naturality squares, excise loose-metaphor rows, and prune correspondences that merely recapitulate the known list. A vanilla model tends to regress to the expert-baseline reachability mapping and to unknowingly re-derive Rosen/MES (low New) or to emit structurally-unfaithful metaphors (fails the hard rules). The capturable delta is concentrated on the isolated novelty axis, so a exploration-agent-style graph+adversarial system should outscore parity here.

Design intent and why this fits C3 / isolates novelty / predicts favored.

WHY IT IS CROSS-DOMAIN SYNTHESIS (C3): It fixes both ends (source = knot theory's formal apparatus; target = corporate ownership/control networks) and demands a relation-for-relation structural map (equivalence relation, invariants, operations), exactly like the calculus->cooking seed but grounded in economics_business and using a far richer, more constrained formal source. It maps the RELATIONSHIPS (Reidemeister-invariance, signed linking, connected sum, unknotting) not the concepts.

WHY IT ISOLATES NOVELTY: Usefulness and surprise are deliberately pinned by the scaffolding so that the free axis is New-ness of the structural correspondence. The hard rules (R1-R7) fix a correctness floor, so a mapping that is merely 'useful/correct' can still be cheap; the expert baseline fixes the surprise reference so that the obvious mapping scores low on Surprising regardless. What is left to vary is whether the agent finds a structural correspondence NOT already occupied by the adjacent territory in the known-answers list — pure novelty of the map.

WHY THE KNOWN-ANSWERS LIST IS BUILT THIS WAY: The exact knot->ownership map is essentially absent from the literature, so New cannot be judged against a prior instance of it. Instead the list pins the adjacent occupied territory a strong agent must clear to legitimately claim novelty: (i) other distant-field-> economics formal imports (econophysics/thermo, gauge theory, tropical geometry, relativity, catastrophe theory, quantum games, fitness landscapes, epidemiology, category theory, persistent homology), and (ii) the incumbent NON-knot formalizations of the same target (Vitali-Glattfelder-Battiston graph model; Brioschi-Buzzacchi-Colombo control matrix; La Porta ultimate-owner chains). An answer that just re-skins those is knocked out by R5/R7.

WHY DEEP MULTI-SOURCE SYNTHESIS IS FORCED (not a single lookup): The agent must simultaneously (1) command knot theory's invariants and the meaning of Reidemeister-invariance, (2) command the corporate-control literature and its existing formal invariant (the (I - C)^{-1} integrated-ownership method), (3) prove invariance of its proposed control invariant under its proposed moves, (4) verify the knot niche is genuinely unoccupied (prior-art search to distinguish it from persistent-homology TDA and from category-theory string diagrams, which look deceptively similar), and (5) ground it in named real cases (keiretsu/chaebol/pyramidal groups, a real divestiture). No single source yields the join.

WHY favored IS PREDICTED (mechanistic-scope hypothesis): A knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent has two decisive edges here. (a) Coverage: it can enumerate the occupied cross-domain-mapping space and the target's incumbent formalisms, letting it confidently locate the empty knot niche and avoid re-deriving a known analogy — the exact failure mode that sinks a linear generator. (b) Adversarial refinement against a formal target: it can test each proposed correspondence against the knot axioms (does the corporate 'move' actually preserve the invariant? does orientation break it?) and prune correspondences that fail R1-R5, converging on the non-obvious signed-linking / writhe / assembly-complexity constructions that clear the expert baseline on Surprising. Both the novelty coverage and the invariance-checking are structure-exploiting operations, which is where mechanistic scope predicts the caesar architecture pulls ahead of parity.

TIME-SENSITIVITY: timeless — every required piece (knot theory, the ownership-control formal apparatus, the named real cases) is stable and pre-cutoff; correctness does not decay and the answer needs no post-cutoff event. The known-answers snapshot is dated 2026-07-29 only to fix the novelty reference set.

This challenge is engineered so that the binding constraint is NEW, with Useful and Surprising held roughly constant by construction, isolating the novelty axis. Two design choices force novelty to be the discriminator: (a) a deliberately rich dated known-answers list (Lehman's laws, the organism/ecosystem metaphor, software phylogenetics, genetic programming, entropy/technical-debt, monoculture arguments) so that the obvious mappings are pre-claimed and earn zero New credit, and (b) hard rules that demand structure-preserving, equation-level correspondences with falsifiable predictions, so surface metaphors cannot score. Under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis, a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent should favored here for three reasons. First, the source field is itself a tightly linked graph of formal relations (Wright-Fisher -> diffusion -> fixation probability -> Ne -> mutation-selection balance -> Hill-Robertson -> error catastrophe -> Price equation), and the task is precisely a graph-alignment / structure-transfer operation: instantiate each node and edge of that relational graph in the target domain -- an operation graph agents are structurally suited to and that scales past the handful of mappings an unaided expert retrieves. Second, the novelty gate makes broad, multi-source prior-art retrieval the decisive edge: to score on New the solver must first enumerate the large surface of already-known biology-to-software analogies across several disjoint literatures (maintenance research, package-ecosystem studies, malware phylogeny, GP/genetic-improvement, DevOps) to avoid re-deriving them -- deep-and-wide retrieval, exactly where the agent beats a deep-but-narrow human who stops at the first-order mutation-selection dictionary. Third, adversarial self-refinement can enforce the hardest requirement of C3 -- checking that a mapped quantity actually satisfies the source equation and pruning correspondences that are only lexical -- which is the step where human intuition typically fails silently. The expert baseline reliably reaches the first-order dictionary and qualitative Muller's-ratchet gesture but rarely delivers the quantitative thresholds (error catastrophe, Ne*s boundary, mu/s equilibrium, ~2s fixation, Price decomposition, Hill-Robertson scaling); those constitute the reachable-but-unclaimed novelty surface that an adversarially refined graph agent is positioned to capture, hence favored rather than parity.

Isolates NOVELTY because both endpoints are fixed -- source = the RG apparatus, target = constitutional allocation of authority across governance scales -- so the creative act is not domain selection but constructing a faithful, previously-unpublished term-by-term isomorphism. The dated known-answers set pins the actual state of the art (economic-equilibrium, cybernetics, reliability-redundancy, CAS-and-law, Galam's RG-on-VOTING, Ostrom polycentricity, horizontal policy diffusion, citation networks, code-is-law, legal-entropy) so New is graded against real prior art rather than the agent's ignorance; the RG<->competence-allocation dictionary is the open, unclaimed slot, and Galam's RG-on-voting work makes 'we used RG on politics' non-novel, forcing genuine differentiation. Requires deep MULTI-SOURCE synthesis: the solver must (a) reconstruct the RG formalism precisely, (b) master comparative multi-level-governance doctrine (Art. 5 TEU subsidiarity, German concurrent legislation Art. 72 GG, U.S. preemption/Supremacy Clause), and (c) survey the sociophysics / physics-of-law literature to prove its dictionary is not Galam/Ostrom/Ruhl -- no single lookup yields this. Predicted CAESAR_WIN under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: a knowledge-graph agent can path from 'federalism' to 'renormalization group' along structural-analogy edges a retrieval baseline will not traverse, and adversarial self-refinement is precisely the mechanism that enforces the relationship-preservation hard rules (beta function as scale-derivative; fixed point as its zero) and that surfaces the semigroup/irreversibility disanalogy and the ratchet prediction; loose or plagiarized analogies are penalized by the known-answers set plus the hard rules, so the marginal return to genuine structural search (the exploration agent's strength) is high relative to a baseline that stops at the shallow expert dictionary. Operational note: live WebSearch verification was blocked (session search budget exhausted, 200/200); the cited dates are well-established pre-cutoff scholarship, and the deep-web-synthesis requirement falls on the SOLVER, not the challenge designer.

Isolates NOVELTY: the two obvious correspondences (fitness landscape ~ PES; evolutionary algorithm for crystal-structure prediction) are pinned down and explicitly disallowed via the dated known-answers list and hard rules, so New is scored only on the deeper, unassembled formal terms (quasispecies error threshold, Fisher's theorem, Price equation, Kimura fixation, epistasis-as-ECI, neutral networks, Muller's ratchet). Usefulness and Surprise are held near-constant by fixing the expert baseline and by requiring exactly one falsifiable transferred prediction and one disanalogy — so the differentiating variable is how far past the known set the agent maps. Predicts CAESAR_WIN under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: the required pieces genuinely exist across four disjoint literatures (population-genetics formalism, energy-landscape/convex-hull theory, cluster-expansion Hamiltonians, materials active-learning), but are nowhere assembled into a single isomorphism. A knowledge-graph agent can retrieve and bridge these scattered nodes (e.g., linking Eigen's error threshold -> order-disorder/high-entropy stabilization, or Fisher variance -> acquisition-function design), and adversarial refinement is exactly what catches the fatal step — that crystals lack heredity, forcing the required disanalogy — which a single-pass model tends to gloss over by asserting a spurious perfect isomorphism. A baseline LLM without graph structure and self-critique typically regurgitates the known genotype/fitness/mutation mapping (low New) or fabricates unpreserved 'equations' (fails hard rules). TIMELESS: every needed formalism predates the cutoff, removing recency as a confound so any measured advantage is attributable to novel synthesis rather than fresh facts; the known-answers list is timestamped only to fix the novelty reference point. Requires deep multi-source synthesis by construction (single-source answers are ruled INVALID).

Category is C4 Meta-Creativity: the deliverable is a METHOD/FRAMEWORK, not an answer, so it is deliberately NOT axis-isolated in the single-axis sense — the design forces all three axes to bind simultaneously (New: measured against a dated list of 17 existing instruments/positions current to 2026-07; Useful: gated by reproducibility, edge-case coverage, discriminating demonstration, and self-limiting scope in HR2/HR5/HR6/HR7; Surprising: measured against a concrete weighted-rubric-plus-remedy-ladder expert baseline). That mutual binding is why axis_isolated='balanced'. Under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis the predicted direction is PARITY: a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent has two structural strengths that map exactly onto this task — (1) broad multi-source synthesis of a heterogeneous, contested corpus (treaty law + ethics + statute + museology + Indigenous sovereignty + 2022-2026 stewardship experiments), which is a KG strength, and (2) stress-testing a candidate procedure against adversarial hard cases (Parthenon, Oba-custodian Benin, NAGPRA ritual object, good-faith purchaser), which is an adversarial-refinement strength. Framework invention here is reachable by principled recombination of existing traditions plus one non-obvious structural mechanism (e.g., title/control decoupling, provenance-uncertainty as a graded variable, iterated sunset-and-renewal consent). Both a strong expert and such an agent can reach that move, but neither has a decisive edge: the agent gains no special leverage from tooling that experts lack, and suffers no structural deficit that would null it out. Hence parity rather than favored (no exploitable single-axis asymmetry, e.g., no huge enumerable answer space to out-search) or predicted_null (the task is well-posed, gradeable, and within reach). time_sensitivity=post_cutoff: correctly judging New requires the 2025-2026 frontier of shared-stewardship/digital-restitution experiments (e.g., the 2026-03 Swiss loan-back arrangement), which post-dates the training cutoff, so parametric recall is insufficient and live multi-source web synthesis is mandatory — satisfying the deep-research requirement. The challenge is distinct from the the exploration agent seed (which invents an evaluation METRIC for AI creativity); this invents a normative-procedural ADJUDICATION framework in a live arts/humanities heritage domain, with no metric-construction overlap.

Category fit (C4 meta-creativity, balanced axis): the task asks the agent to INVENT a scoring framework, not to retrieve an answer, and the forbidden-ingredient constraint (banning p-values, effect sizes, N/power, prestige, and human-opinion aggregation) blocks the entire standard replication-prediction toolkit (p-curve, R-index, z-curve, prediction markets, SCORE/repliCATS elicitation), forcing genuine construction. It cannot be won on any single axis: a submission that is merely New (an exotic metric) fails Useful unless it is calibrated against real replication outcomes; one that is merely Useful (an ARRIVE-style checklist) fails New/Surprising because that baseline already exists; Surprising requires a non-obvious feature (e.g., causal-graph topology of the mechanism, counterfactual assay-redundancy, or entailment-based mechanistic consistency) that still survives validation -- so all three must move together, which is why the axis is balanced. Deep multi-source synthesis is mandatory: a good answer must weave the metascience literature (RP:Psychology/RP:Cancer Biology, SCORE, prediction-market and ML-replication work), preclinical reagent-provenance resources (ICLAC/Cellosaurus, RRIDs, antibody validation, YCharOS), integrity-forensics methods (Bik/ImageTwin), and reporting standards (ARRIVE 2.0, Landis, SciScore) into one calibrated construction with a leakage-proof validation plan -- no single page contains this. Grounding: it is squarely biology_medicine (preclinical in vitro/animal causal claims, cell-line and antibody provenance, the Amgen/Bayer irreproducibility problem), and a generic metascience port from psychology is explicitly ruled out by the domain-grounding hard rule. Time sensitivity is timeless: the invention does not hinge on any post-cutoff event, and every known-answer anchor is pre-cutoff, so New is judged against a fixed, dated corpus. Predicted direction = parity under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent should comfortably assemble the known components (reagent DBs as graph nodes, convergent-evidence counting, integrity forensics, checklist rigor) and adversarial self-critique naturally satisfies the required spuriousness test -- so it should reach the expert MPICS-level baseline; but the ceiling move (a truly surprising, validated feature such as mechanistic-graph entropy or LLM-entailment-based causal-consistency that beats the checklist baseline on RP:CB) is a creative leap not guaranteed by graph-lookup + refinement, so the agent should match rather than exceed the expert baseline -- i.e., parity, not favored, and not a predicted null since a competent, gradeable answer is clearly reachable.

Grounding & multi-source requirement: Valuing proprietary data as an auditable asset is a genuinely open problem — IAS 38 forbids capitalizing internally generated data, so there is no accepted standard, and the competing methods live in four disconnected literatures (accounting standards; CHS/OECD intangible and national-accounts economics; ML data-valuation via Shapley/influence; and consumer-surplus/data-market measurement à la Brynjolfsson and Dawex/AWS Data Exchange). A solver cannot lift the answer from any single page; it must survey and reconcile all four, which forces deep web synthesis rather than a fact lookup.

Why it isolates the BALANCED axis: The four hard requirements are engineered so no single sub-score can carry a passing solution. A dazzling but uncomputable metric fails Useful (rule 2, auditability). A perfectly computable method that is just Data Shapley in new clothes fails New (rule 4, no relabeling). And a method that simply reproduces the expert hybrid income-plus-contribution baseline is Useful and somewhat New but scores low on Surprising. Only a submission that is simultaneously novel versus the dated list, operationally auditable, AND organized around a non-obvious principle clears all three at once — which is exactly the definition of the balanced axis.

Why PARITY under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: Meta-creativity here rewards broad recombination of many pre-existing frameworks plus disciplined adversarial stress-testing against the four properties and the auditability bar. A knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent is well-suited to both moves — it can retrieve and fuse the disparate valuation literatures (its strength) and iteratively check a candidate framework against each failure mode (adversarial refinement's strength). But the ceiling of the task is a well-integrated synthesis, not a leap that depends on tacit market intuition or embodied institutional experience that would advantage a exploration-agent-style knowledge-graph agent decisively. Because both a strong baseline agent and the mechanistic agent can converge on a competent, balanced synthesis, and neither gets a structural edge on the surprising organizing-principle move, the predicted outcome is parity rather than a the exploration agent win.

Time sensitivity: timeless — the invention is evaluable independent of any post-cutoff event; all prior art is pre-cutoff, and the known-answers list is dated purely to fix the reference against which New is scored.

Axis isolation (balanced): The prompt is deliberately engineered so no single creativity axis can carry a passing answer. New is pinned by the 15-item dated prior-art list (FoS, LRFD, beta/FORM, Cp/Cpk, Six Sigma, Taguchi, info-gap, QMU, PRA/FMEA, Sobol', Suh's Information Axiom, AIAA/INCOSE margins, RBDO, resilience/antifragility, set-based design) — a submission that merely relabels one of these fails New. Useful is pinned by hard rules 1–2 and 6–8 (design-review computability, dimensional invariance, falsifiable validation, reproducibility) — a clever but non-operational construct fails Useful. Surprising is pinned by hard rule 3 plus the expert baseline: since the obvious expert move (excess-beta or M/U or alpha-hat, normalized by a resource) is written out as the reference, an answer that lands on it scores low Surprising even if New and Useful. Passing therefore requires all three jointly — the definition of the balanced axis.

Predicted direction = parity (matches the mechanistic-scope hypothesis): A knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent is expected to be COMPETITIVE-not-dominant here rather than for the exploration agent to win. The reason: meta-creativity over a well-charted design space is largely disciplined recombination of enumerable prior frameworks (nodes in the KG: reliability theory, quality engineering, decision-under-uncertainty, sensitivity analysis, metrology) under explicit adversarial constraints — and the hard rules ARE the adversary (must-not-reduce-to-beta/Cpk, must-degrade-under-Knightian-uncertainty, must-state-invariance-group, must-self-critique-gaming). Those are exactly the checks an adversarial-refinement loop already runs, so the mechanistic baseline can reach the same recombinant frontier (e.g., resource-normalized M/U, or an information/exergy analogy suggested by adjacent KG nodes). the exploration agent's edge — open-ended divergent leaps beyond charted prior art — is muted because the surprising region (information-theoretic channel-capacity, exergy option-value, safe-set packing geometry) is reachable by analogy-hops the KG supports. Net expectation: comparable New/Useful/Surprising scores, i.e., parity.

Deep multi-source web synthesis (required, not a lookup): No single source defines cross-domain margin efficiency. A strong answer must reconcile structural-reliability beta (civil), QMU M/U (defense/national-lab), info-gap alpha-hat (decision theory), Cp/Cpk and Six Sigma (manufacturing quality), Sobol' indices (UQ), Suh's information content (design theory), and AIAA/INCOSE margin bookkeeping (aerospace systems), then impose a dimensional-analysis normalization — a synthesis spanning at least six literatures, each with different assumptions about what 'uncertainty' and 'margin' mean.

Time sensitivity = timeless: This is an invention task with no dated answer key; the prior art anchoring New is stable, pre-cutoff literature (latest anchors: AIAA S-120 2006, resilience engineering 2006, QMU NAS review 2009, antifragility 2012), and nothing in the challenge turns on facts that change after the training cutoff. Grader note: score New against the dated list above; score Surprising against the expert baseline's 'ratio-of-existing-margin-to-resource' template, treating departures from that template (information-theoretic, thermodynamic/exergy, or geometric safe-set constructions) as the surprising region; a valid submission must satisfy every hard rule, and rule 3's explicit separating design-pair is the fastest disqualifier for relabeled prior art.

Meta-creativity here is the invention of a measurement framework, and the underlying corpus (Stigler -> Laffont-Tirole -> Carpenter-Moss -> Libgober/Yackee/You + text-as-data) is mature and densely mapped. Under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis, a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent should perform at PARITY because the creative act reduces to: (i) enumerating existing capture measures on the graph, (ii) locating the gap the banned-proxy constraint opens, and (iii) recombining standard identification strategies (event studies, diff-in-diff around leadership turnover or remands, text-as-data, revealed preference) into a constraint-satisfying estimator plus falsification test. Adversarial refinement is genuinely well-suited to the two built-in traps — the 'capture vs. legitimate agreement' confound and the mandatory falsification test — so the exploration agent's stress-testing loop should lift Useful and confound-handling; but that same benefit is reachable by a strong non-adversarial baseline through knowledge-graph recombination, and NEITHER path requires a conceptual leap outside the corpus. New and Surprising are both gated on finding an identifying move beyond text-convergence (e.g., non-enforcement signals, response-to-comments revealed preference, turnover/remand natural experiments); both architectures reach such moves by recombination at roughly equal rates. Hence balanced parity across New/Useful/Surprising rather than a the exploration agent win. A the exploration agent edge would appear only if the surprising identifying assumption lay outside recombinable graph content — which this well-charted law/econ/poli-sci corpus does not force — so the isolate-the-balanced-axis design tests exactly the boundary where adversarial refinement stops adding marginal creativity.

Design intent and axis isolation: This is a C4 meta-creativity item — the agent must invent a method (a discovery-value metric), not retrieve a material. It isolates the BALANCED axis because a passing submission must be simultaneously New (not a re-label of SUN, StructureMatcher, Krivovichev complexity, or the CD index), Useful (fully specified, computable, and validated with a stated quantitative threshold), and Surprising (a reframing the expert baseline does not anticipate). No single axis is spotlighted or suppressed: the hard rules force usefulness (definition + pipeline + falsifiable validation), the dated known-answers list pins novelty, and the expert baseline anchors surprise. A submission that is very novel but non-computable, or very useful but a straight generalization of SUN, is penalized equally — that is what 'balanced' means here.

Why it requires deep multi-source web synthesis: to even know what counts as New the agent must survey five disjoint literatures — generative-ML novelty metrics (SUN, CDVAE novelty rates), crystallographic complexity (Krivovichev), descriptor/embedding spaces (Magpie, SOAP, Mat2Vec), synthesizability prediction (PU-learning, energy-above-hull), and the explicitly-excluded bibliometric disruption family (CD index, Uzzi atypicality) — and it must locate real reference databases (Materials Project, ICSD, OQMD, AFLOW, GNoME) and a real temporally-held-out landmark set to design a passing validation protocol. No single page yields the framework; the value is in cross-domain recombination and in constructing a checkable validation design. It is genuinely open (no consensus metric exists as of 2026-07-29) and hard.

Why predicted direction is parity (mechanistic-scope hypothesis): the raw ingredients are well-documented and equally retrievable by any competent deep-research agent, so a knowledge-graph advantage is largely neutralized — graph coverage does not create the missing reframing, it only surfaces components everyone can find. Adversarial/critic-style refinement chiefly hardens Usefulness and internal consistency (it defends the definition and validation against attack) but does not systematically manufacture the low-probability conceptual reframing that Surprise rewards; if anything, critic pressure biases toward the safe, defensible expert-baseline construction. And the Surprise ceiling is bounded by an unusually rich expert prior — many partial metrics already exist — so novel reframings are scarce rather than reliably produced by graph+adversarial mechanics. Net: a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent (the exploration agent) should land at PARITY with the baseline on this item, gaining on Useful but not clearly on New or Surprising, so the combined creative (all-three) score shows no systematic the exploration agent advantage.

Dating/label: pre_cutoff — the entire known-answers landscape used to judge New is established before the training cutoff and the challenge has no post-cutoff factual dependency, so a strong pre-cutoff-knowledge agent has everything it needs and novelty is judged against a fully-dated (2026-07-29) prior-art list.

DESIGN / ISOLATION: This is a C5 open-ended-synthesis task (many valid new forms exist) engineered to isolate NOVELTY. Usefulness is held near-constant and low-variance by the hard rules (any answer that clears the reproducibility + zero-violation bar is about equally 'useful' as a poetic form), and Surprise largely tracks Novelty here (a form is surprising precisely when its organizing principle is one no tradition has used). So the discriminating axis is New: is the DEFINING principle genuinely absent from the dated catalogue? The catalogue is deliberately broad and cross-lingual (Romance, Arabic/Persian, Chinese tonal, Japanese/Korean syllabic, Celtic/Norse sound-braiding, Oulipo, and recent coinages like Fib/golden-shovel/duplex) so that the easy recombinations are pre-claimed and the agent cannot win by fusing two known forms — the collision hard rule fires. Judging novelty therefore REQUIRES deep multi-source synthesis: the space of formal principles is scattered across many traditions and languages, and confirming that a proposed principle is unoccupied is itself a research task, not a single lookup. WHY predicted_null under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent (exploration-agent-style) has genuine scope over the VERIFICATION half of this task — it can canvass traditions and prune proposals that collide with known nodes, which protects Useful and prevents obvious New=1 failures. But its mechanism does not confer advantage on the GENERATIVE leap the novelty axis rewards: introducing a constraint of a new TYPE (semantic/relational/topological rather than phonetic/metrical). Graph recombination tends to interpolate WITHIN the manifold of catalogued principles, and adversarial refinement optimizes toward what the survey rewards — both pressures push answers toward high-quality recombinations (the expert-baseline 'Diminishing Spiral' region) rather than off-manifold invention. Net effect: the agent should match, not beat, a strong open-generation baseline on New/Surprising — parity, i.e., no the exploration agent win. (If anything the recombination bias risks catalogue collisions that a free-generating baseline avoids, which could push slightly below parity, but the conservative, pre-registered prediction is null.) TIME-SENSITIVITY: timeless — the invention task is not tied to any dated event; the known-answers list is a Jan-2026 snapshot used only as the novelty reference, and post-cutoff form coinages would simply be appended to that reference rather than changing the task.

Why this isolates NOVELTY: the task is pure open-ended synthesis with an unbounded valid-answer set, and the operative bar is 'categorically new modality class that does not already exist.' Useful and Surprising are held down to supporting/gating roles (R7 gates Useful; the expert_baseline anchors Surprising), so the dominant scored signal is New — did the agent produce a mechanism absent from the dated known-answers list and prior art. Why it needs deep multi-source synthesis: to even avoid a false-novelty claim the agent must survey the entire modality taxonomy (25+ classes spanning pharmacology, oligonucleotides, gene/epigenetic editing, cell therapy, microbiome, radioligands, devices) PLUS the 2024-2026 emerging edge (RNA editing, epigenetic editors, in vivo CAR, de novo protein design) PLUS the patent landscape and the undruggable-target literature; no single lookup can establish that a proposed mechanism is genuinely absent. Why predicted_null under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis: a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent (exploration-agent-style) gains its edge on tasks that offer (i) a well-structured relational space to recombine within and (ii) a verifiable target the adversarial critic can push toward. Open-ended novelty generation offers neither — there is no external verifier that reliably separates a 'genuinely new modality class' from a 'clever relabeling,' and there is no optimization target to refine against, only open concept space to sample. The KG supplies exactly the catalog of KNOWN modalities (which biases toward recombination of existing nodes, the opposite of categorical novelty), and the adversarial refiner can prune implausible or derivative answers but cannot manufacture a primitive that lies outside the graph. So the mechanism confers no measurable lift over a strong base agent on the isolated New axis: the hypothesis predicts a null effect here (predicted_null) rather than a the exploration agent win. Time-sensitivity is 'timeless' because the creative act does not hinge on any post-cutoff event; however, the known-answers list is current only to the training cutoff, so a live-web agent must re-verify the 2026 emerging-modality and patent frontier before claiming novelty — the list above should be treated as a dated floor (as of 28 July 2026), not a ceiling.

DESIGN. The challenge instantiates C5 Open-Ended Synthesis in economics_business by asking the agent to invent a market mechanism that fills a documented 'missing market.' It requires deep multi-source web synthesis, not a lookup: the agent must integrate (i) the academic market-design / incomplete-markets literature (Arrow-Debreu completeness, Roth on repugnant/matching markets, Shiller's macro markets, Weyl-Posner) to identify and justify a genuine market failure, (ii) the current fintech/crypto/regulatory landscape (2023-2026) to prove the idea is not already deployed or piloted, and (iii) its own constructive mechanism design — three distinct evidence bases that no single source spans. ISOLATING NOVELTY. Usefulness and Surprise are deliberately pinned so that New is the free axis: a usefulness FLOOR is enforced by requiring a real, cited missing market plus an explicit incentive-compatibility argument and buildable-now constraint (rules 1, 2, 5), and Surprise is given a fixed reference via the expert baseline and its 'unsurprising region.' What the agent actually controls, and what the score therefore reflects, is whether it lands in an empty (missing-market x mechanism) cell versus recombining nodes already on the dated known-answers list. Rules 3-4 and the two named traps (prediction-market-on-X, tokenize-X) are the false-novelty filter. TIME-SENSITIVITY. Labeled timeless: inventing a new mechanism needs no post-cutoff fact, though the known-answers list is a snapshot dated 2026-07-28 and should be refreshed before re-scoring (the novelty bar rises as the landscape fills). PREDICTED DIRECTION = predicted_null (parity; no the exploration agent win). Under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis, a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent excels when there is a bounded, well-structured space and a verifiable target it can prune toward. This task has neither: the output space of 'not-yet-existing mechanisms' is combinatorially open and there is no external verifier for 'genuinely new.' The KG anchors the agent to already-catalogued entities (exactly the known-answers list), and adversarial refinement optimizes internal coherence/usefulness — its strength — which pulls proposals BACK toward well-formed recombinations of known instruments, suppressing the New axis. So on the isolated novelty axis the KG+refinement machinery should confer no advantage over a strong generic generative baseline (and may even anchor harder to the known set), predicting parity rather than a the exploration agent win. This makes C5/novelty a discriminating negative control for the hypothesis: a the exploration agent win here would be evidence AGAINST mechanistic-scope, while parity confirms the scope boundary.

Axis isolation: The challenge is engineered so that Useful and Surprising are held near-constant while Novelty is the discriminating axis. Usefulness is reduced to a gated pass/fail by hard rules 1-8 (feasibility, thermodynamics, scaling, quantified target) — any submission clearing the gate solves a real problem, so it does not spread scores. Surprising is anchored by an explicit expert baseline (a competent two-technology recombination) that fixes the reference expectation. The only thing left to separate a creative answer from a mediocre one is whether the inventive step is genuinely absent from a large, well-mapped prior-art space — i.e., New. Rules 3 and 4 (no duplication of the dated list, no mere off-the-shelf integration) sharpen this: they force the novelty to live in the inventive step itself, not in packaging or application. Why deep multi-source web synthesis is required (not a single lookup): to substantiate novelty the agent must landscape prior art across three heterogeneous corpora that no single query spans — granted patents (USPTO/EPO/Google Patents), the peer-reviewed/preprint literature (IEEE/arXiv/Nature-family), and shipping-product datasheets — and then locate an unoccupied white space across all three simultaneously. That cross-corpus intersection-and-gap search is the synthesis burden; a single fact cannot answer it, and a shallow search will falsely claim novelty for something already patented or productized. Time sensitivity = pre_cutoff: the raw material is established engineering physics and a prior-art baseline captured in the dated known-answers list (all documented before the cutoff); the difficulty is synthesis breadth, not retrieval of a post-cutoff fact. Predicted direction = predicted_null (mechanistic-scope hypothesis): a knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent's mechanistic strengths are (i) recombination among nodes that already exist in its graph and (ii) critique/constraint-satisfaction that polishes and validates candidates. Both strengths map onto Useful and, in constrained categories, onto Surprising — but neither generates true white-space novelty. Genuine invention here requires producing an inventive step that lies OUTSIDE the union of the graph's nodes and their obvious edges, and hard rule 4 explicitly bans the two-node recombination the graph is best at. Adversarial refinement can prune infeasible or non-novel candidates but cannot manufacture out-of-distribution novelty; it converges toward the expert baseline rather than beyond it. Hence on this pure-novelty, open-ended synthesis task the agent should perform at parity with a strong baseline — no significant the exploration agent win — which is the predicted_null outcome the benchmark is designed to detect for this category.

Category/axis: This is a C5 Open-Ended Synthesis item — an ill-defined generative task with many valid answers and no single correct instrument — designed to isolate the NOVELTY (New) axis. New is the discriminating axis: it is judged against the dated known-answers list (a snapshot of the worldwide future-generations institutional landscape as of 2026-07-29), so a submission earns New only by escaping that whole design space, not by producing one more entrenched-commissioner variant. Useful and Surprising are still scored (CREST requires all three to hold for a 'creative' verdict), but the challenge is tuned so the pass/fail hinges on genuine institutional novelty; the expert baseline is supplied precisely so Surprising has a concrete reference point to beat.

Why it requires deep multi-source web synthesis (not a single lookup): confirming that a proposed instrument exists in NO jurisdiction is an open-world negative that cannot be settled from memory or one page. The known landscape is large and deliberately dispersed — national statutes (Wales, Malta), parliamentary bodies (Finland, Israel, Hungary), constitutional clauses (Germany, Norway), apex-court doctrine (Neubauer, Urgenda, Juliana, Oposa), UN soft law (Summit of the Future 2024), rights-of-nature proxies, sovereign-wealth/fiscal rules, a book-length academic taxonomy, and deliberative experiments (Japan's Future Design). An agent must integrate statutes, case law, IGO documents, and gray literature across many languages and venues both to avoid accidental duplication and to argue novelty credibly.

Time-sensitivity: labeled timeless — the invention is not event-dependent and can be attempted at any date; the known-answers snapshot is dated (essentially all pre-cutoff), so novelty is graded against a fixed reference, while confirming non-existence still mandates live search.

Predicted direction — predicted_null (mechanistic-scope hypothesis): A knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent like the exploration agent draws its documented edge from tasks with relational anchor structure — cross-domain bridging (C3, its strongest axis) and counterfactual refinement of a fixed proposition (C2). Open-ended novel invention offers neither: there is no anchor proposition for the KG to bridge between, and the adversarial critic has no fixed target to refine toward — it can prune/pressure-test candidates but does not generate genuinely new institutional forms, which is a divergent-generation task where general Deep-Research baselines (Sonnet/Gemini/GPT) are at parity or better. This matches the exploration agent's paper-documented C5 reverse result (7-15). Expectation: no the exploration agent advantage over strong general baselines on the New axis here — hence predicted_null.

Design intent: this is a C5 Open-Ended Synthesis task (many valid answers) constructed to isolate the NOVELTY (New) axis. The prompt demands an object that 'does not yet exist' and makes the load-bearing deliverable an evidence-backed novelty defense (component 6), so scoring weight falls on New; Usefulness is deliberately de-emphasized (the emergent property need only be unique, not practically valuable) and Surprise is bounded by the supplied expert baseline. The dated known-answers list (~30+ catalogued families, dated 2026-07-29) is what New is judged against, and the hard rules block the cheap wins (a new MOF linker, a new HEA element-set, an A/B/X swap in a perovskite, or a physical composite), forcing a genuinely new organizing principle. Multi-source web synthesis is intrinsic and unavoidable: proving a principle-composition-structure combination is ABSENT can only be done by cross-referencing review literature, crystallographic/property databases (Materials Project, ICSD, CSD), the patent record, and 2025-2026 preprints — a single-fact lookup can never establish non-existence, only fail to recall a prior example. Time-sensitivity is pre_cutoff because the reference landscape (the families to be distinct from) and the expert baseline are all established pre-cutoff knowledge; the web phase is negative-verification across many sources plus a recency scan, not retrieval of a post-cutoff fact.\n\nPredicted direction = predicted_null under the mechanistic-scope hypothesis. A knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent (the exploration agent) draws its edge from grounded multi-hop retrieval and from adversarial fact-checking that prunes unsupported claims and converges toward corroborated, consensus answers. On the New axis this machinery is orthogonal to the creative act and may even be counterproductive: (i) the knowledge graph is, by construction, a map of what is ALREADY known — traversing it surfaces existing families and their neighbors, biasing generation back toward the catalogued manifold rather than beyond it; (ii) adversarial refinement rewards claims with strong source support, but a genuinely new organizing principle has, by definition, zero corroborating sources, so the refinement step penalizes exactly the proposals that would score highest on New, pulling outputs toward well-attested (hence non-novel) two-family hybrids like the expert baseline. The mechanism helps establish the negative-verification of component (6) and sharpens grounding of components (2)-(4), but those feed Useful/verifiable quality, not the generative leap the New score rewards. Net effect on the isolated New axis: no significant advantage over a strong unstructured generative baseline — parity, i.e., predicted_null. This is the discriminating prediction: if the exploration agent were to win here, it would falsify the claim that its gains are scope-limited to grounded/constrained synthesis and absent on open-ended pure-novelty generation.

AXIS ISOLATION (usefulness). The strict, countable rules — parametric line/stanza generation, verifiable syllable counts, a blind-decodable ordinal channel, and line-by-line self-consistency of the N=8 example — make this a convergent, checkable design problem. The space of structurally LEGAL answers is narrow and largely shared, so Novelty and Surprise have little room to vary independently, while an answer's value is dominated by one question: does the form actually preserve order-accurate recall better than free prose and than the nearest existing form? That pins the scored variance onto usefulness. The dated known-answers list forecloses the obvious permutational/mnemonic moves (sestina/quenine spiral, Vedic krama/jata/ghana, method of loci, calendar mnemonics), holding New and Surprising near-constant so usefulness is the axis on which answers meaningfully separate.

DEEP MULTI-SOURCE SYNTHESIS. No single source yields the deliverable. The agent must reconcile (1) the formal combinatorics of the quenine/Queneau-number permutation, (2) the order-preserving mechanics of Vedic krama/jata/ghana recitation, (3) the rule-sets of existing fixed forms (to prove distinctness in 3+ features), (4) serial-recall cognitive science (serial-position effect, chunking, generation effect, cued recall), and (5) historical evidence on oral-formulaic transmission fidelity — then invent and internally VERIFY a new artifact. These literatures live in disjoint corpora (Oulipo/combinatorics studies, Indology, literary prosody, memory psychology, classics/folklore); the value is in the cross-walk, not any lookup, so it is not answerable from one page.

PREDICTED_NULL (mechanistic-scope hypothesis). A knowledge-graph + adversarial-refinement agent ('the exploration agent') earns its edge by surfacing distant graph connections and stress-testing them — an advantage that surfaces as Novelty/Surprise. Here the binding constraint is usefulness under tight, convergent rules, where the high-value solution region is already well-charted by expert prior art (quenine + krama + loci + serial-recall theory). Graph-distance ideation does not improve order-preservation efficacy or rule-legality, and adversarial refinement mostly rediscovers the known convergent optimum. the exploration agent is therefore predicted to reach PARITY with, not exceed, a strong expert baseline on the aggregate creativity score — a null result. The item functions as a negative control for the claim that the exploration agent's mechanism is scoped to novelty/surprise rather than to constrained usefulness.

GROUNDING & TIME-SENSITIVITY. All required ingredients (troubadour/Oulipo prosody, Sanskrit recitation, memory rhetoric, serial-recall psychology) are established, pre-cutoff scholarship; the task is invention and justification rather than retrieval of post-cutoff events, so it is timeless — evaluable at any date, with novelty judged against the known-answers snapshot dated 2026-07-28. The domain is squarely arts_humanities (literary form, prosody, oral tradition, poetics), with cognitive science recruited only to substantiate the usefulness claim. Note: WebSearch budget was exhausted before verification; the load-bearing facts (sestina retrogradatio cruciata, Queneau numbers/quenine, Vedic vikriti-patha ordering, Cisiojanus, drottkvaett, ars memoriae) are stable, widely-documented pre-cutoff scholarship, but an evaluator should spot-check the quenine primitive-root condition and the jata/ghana permutation patterns before deployment.

Isolates novelty: literal backlog/staffing queues are gated, so New credit requires importing variability-amplification or feedback-routing into a non-backlog legal structure. Useful: bounded grades and tie-breaks make it reproducible and actionable. Surprising: it can rank a phenotypically weaker model above a phenotypically similar one, inverting the predictive-validity-dominates baseline. All three axes bind, so predicted_direction is parity.

C5 open-ended item isolating novelty. The prompt is intentionally light so many valid indices exist; usefulness is pinned only by a minimal computability-and-sourcing floor. Because inventing an unmeasured indicator rewards blind variation over deep retrieval, a research agent's synthesis mechanism gives no directional edge over a strong baseline, so predicted_direction = predicted_null. Multi-source web work is still needed to prove the concept is absent from published indicators, establishing New rather than a mechanism advantage.
